nav.subtitle: Debian Server
nav.footer: Metadata lives in SQLite. Runtime state comes from the operating system.
nav.noPlugins: No plugins in the plugins/ folder yet.

pluginManager.title: Plugins
pluginManager.lead: All plugins ship with GoDeb. A disabled plugin disappears from the navigation, its API stops answering and its services are stopped. Enabling needs its packages installed.
pluginManager.empty: No plugin.json in the plugins/ folder.

login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: Signed in as {{user}}. Enter the 6-digit code or a backup code.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.hint: The choice applies immediately in this browser and is stored for the account.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Load and identity of this host. Runtime data comes from the operating system.
overview.sample: Part of the host data is a Debian sample value.

panel.mocked: Sample data. The Debian path or command could not be run on this host.

app.unknownBody: No plugins/ folder with a valid manifest.json exists for {{id}}.
app.notReady: The folder exists, but the Go handler is not registered.
app.noView: The React view is still missing.

fail2ban.title: Fail2ban
fail2ban.description: Jails from fail2ban-client status. Unban applies to every jail.
fail2ban.noneBlocked: No IP is blocked right now.

logs.title: Log
logs.description: Log of the web interface and the root agent from the systemd journal: sign-ins, actions with user and result, failed commands. More detail with GODEB_LOG_LEVEL=debug.

monitor.title: Monitoring
monitor.description: Server health, history and events. Sampled every 10 seconds, history up to one year.
monitor.notChecked: The first check is still running.
monitor.noData: No samples in this time range yet.
monitor.noEvents: No events in this time range.

games.unavailable: The Steam plugin is not active.
games.none: No game server set up yet.
games.noQuery: The server does not answer the Steam query (yet). That is normal while it starts.

network.noAccounting: No counters yet. The agent creates the table inet godeb_acct on its first run (needs nftables).
network.noBytes: The kernel counts bytes per connection only with net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_acct=1, so the list shows counts only.

access.noBlocks: No blocks logged (ufw logging off or nothing blocked).
access.clamped: Access is read straight from the journal and goes back at most 7 days.

sites.none: No sites yet. "godeb site add" on the hub creates one.

alerts.intro: GoDeb sends a message for new problems and warnings, and optionally when they are resolved. The same finding is repeated at most every 6 hours unless it gets worse. On the hub, problems of the sites count too.
alerts.mailMissing: Mail is not set up yet: {{detail}}
alerts.ntfyHint: Install the ntfy app on the phone and subscribe to the same topic. The topic is the password: make it long and random.
alerts.note: Unusually high traffic or CPU load counts as a hint, ten times the usual value as a warning. GoDeb learns the usual values from the history (first values after three days).

apt.title: APT
apt.description: Packages apt list --upgradable reports as upgradeable.

certbot.title: Certbot
certbot.description: Certificate metadata from /etc/letsencrypt/live. Private keys are not read.
certbot.name: Name
certbot.subject: Subject

systemd.title: Systemd
systemd.description: Loaded services. Start and stop run through systemctl.

ufw.title: UFW
ufw.description: Firewall status from ufw status. New rules are applied with ufw --force.

wg.title: WireGuard
wg.description: Peers from {{path}} and wg show. Client configs live under /etc/wireguard/clients.
wg.name: Name
wg.excludedHint: These networks are subtracted from AllowedIPs (e.g. all traffic through the tunnel except your LAN).
wg.needConfig: Peers cannot be created without a readable wg0.conf.
wg.qrHint: Scan it in the WireGuard app.
wg.emailHint: The file contains a private key.
wg.androidDescription: GoDeb WireGuard APK with smart auto-disconnect on trusted networks.
wg.androidUnavailable: No APK on the server yet. Place a signed build at {{path}}.
wg.androidQrHint: After install: import the peer via QR or .conf, then enable auto-disconnect.
wg.siteLabel: Site (GoDeb server behind this hub, e.g. the home VM)
wg.siteHint: Tunnel network only, no DNS, keepalive 25. Phone and laptop reach the site's web UI through this hub.
wg.siteNext: The file {{name}}.conf is being downloaded. On the site, choose "Join a hub" in the wizard and upload it there (or use "godeb setup --join").
wg.peerRoleText: This server is connected to hub {{hub}} with address {{address}}. Create new clients and sites on the hub.
wg.joinText: No wg0 yet. Paste the client file the hub created for this site (godeb site add or “Site” for a new peer). Only keys, address, endpoint, AllowedIPs inside the tunnel network and keepalive are accepted.
wg.trustDescription: On the home Wi-Fi the GoDeb WireGuard app asks this server directly (outside the tunnel). It signs the request with its own key; only then the app switches the tunnel off. A foreign network cannot fake this.
wg.trustRunning: Active – answers requests from the home network.
wg.trustNotRunning: Enabled, but the listener is not running. {{error}}
wg.trustSynced: {{count}} client file(s) updated. Re-scan the QR code on the devices.
wg.trustHubHint: New clients get the trusted endpoints of this server and all sites in their configuration automatically. After changes on a site, “Update client files” and re-scan the QR code.
wg.trustPeerHint: The hub copies address and key into new phone configurations automatically. Existing ones: “Update client files” on the hub, then re-scan the QR code.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enroll.intro: 2FA is mandatory for this account. You need an authenticator app.
enroll.scan: 1. Scan the QR code with the app
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
enroll.manual: Cannot scan? Enter the key manually:
enroll.warning: Print or store them safely! Each code works exactly once.

mailgw.title: Mail gateway
mailgw.description: Postfix stores inbound and outbound mail and forwards it to the home server through the WireGuard tunnel.
mailgw.relayHint: Next hop {{host}}:25. While it is unreachable, mail stays in the queue.
mailgw.noDomain: No domain yet. The DNS check starts after setup.
mailgw.flushed: The queue was asked to deliver.

ens.name: Server name
ens.customHint: Edit individual gameSettings values in the File view.
ens.noGroups: No groups: the server is open without a password.

steam.installHintSeeded: The server files are already present. Installing only validates them (SteamCMD validate), fetches what is missing and sets up Wine, config, service and firewall.
steam.defaultShown: No file yet. Showing the template that is written on save or install.
steam.notObject: The file must be a JSON object.
steam.fixJsonFirst: Fix the JSON first, then switch to the simple view.
steam.saved: Saved. Takes effect on the next server start.
steam.behindHub: This server is connected to hub {{hub}}. Players connect to {{hub}}:{{port}}. The hub needs a port forwarding for {{ports}}/udp to {{address}} (plugin “Port forwarding”, template Enshrouded). Here the ports are open inside the tunnel only.
steam.title: Game servers
steam.description: Dedicated game servers via SteamCMD. Each game runs as its own user in a sandboxed systemd service; Windows servers run under Wine.
steam.installHint: Installs SteamCMD{{wine}}, downloads the server (about {{size}} GB), creates config and service and opens the UDP ports. Takes 5–20 minutes depending on the connection. The server needs about {{memory}} GB RAM.

stepUp.title: Confirm with 2FA
stepUp.window: This action changes the server. Enter a current code from your authenticator app. It then covers further actions for 5 minutes.
stepUp.critical: This action can change access to the server or install software. It needs a new code every time.
stepUp.backupHint: Without your phone, a backup code works too. Each code works once: wait for the next code before the next action.
stepUp.remaining_one: {{count}} attempt left, then the session ends.
stepUp.remaining_other: {{count}} attempts left, then the session ends.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Every device you are signed in on. Ended sessions stop working immediately.

pf.title: Port forwarding
pf.description: Forwards public ports of this hub through the WireGuard tunnel to a site, for example the Enshrouded server on the home VM. NAT in an nftables table of its own, allowed via ufw route.
pf.name: Name
pf.rulesHint: Ports from 1024, at most 1000 per rule. SSH, WireGuard and the GoDeb UI cannot be forwarded. Every change needs a fresh 2FA code.
pf.snatHint: Replies return through the tunnel because the hub rewrites the source address to {{hub}}. The service on the site therefore sees every connection from {{hub}}; banning players by IP does not work there.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.adminText: The first user manages this server. In the next step you set up two-factor sign-in.
setup.tokenHint: Part of the link from “sudo godeb setup-url” or in /etc/godeb/setup-token.
setup.roleText: Should this server be a WireGuard server, connect to an existing GoDeb server or run without WireGuard? The plugin stays available either way.
setup.roleHubText: For a VPS with a public IP. Phones, laptops and sites connect here.
setup.rolePeerText: For the home VM behind a GoDeb VPS. The client file comes from there (godeb site add).
setup.roleNoneText: Manage from the home network or locally only.
setup.endpointHint: IP or host name clients use to reach this server.
setup.joinHint: Upload the file from the hub (WireGuard → add a site downloads it) or paste the content of /etc/wireguard/clients/<name>.conf.
setup.qrAlt: QR code of the first client
setup.qrHint: Scan with the GoDeb WireGuard app. The code contains the client's private key.
setup.joinNoHandshake: No handshake with the hub yet.
setup.accessText: How should the interface be reachable after setup? This setup page closes afterwards.
setup.accessTunnelText: Safest: only from the tunnel (http://10.8.0.x:8080). Recommended for a VPS.
setup.accessLanText: Also via HTTPS from your own LAN, allowed for that subnet only.
setup.trust: Offer the trusted endpoint in the home network
setup.trustHint: The GoDeb WireGuard app then switches the tunnel off on the home Wi-Fi.
setup.firewallActive: Add rules to the active firewall (ufw)
setup.firewallHint: SSH ({{ports}}/tcp) stays open, otherwise only what is needed. The setup port gets closed.
setup.firewallNoSsh: SSH port not detected, so ufw stays off.
setup.ufwMissing: ufw is not installed; please set up the firewall yourself.
setup.doneText: Setup is complete. You now reach the interface here:
setup.nextTunnel: Connect the tunnel, then open http://<tunnel address>:8080
setup.listenerClosed: This setup page is no longer reachable from now on.
setup.summaryHint: Everything at a glance. Best print it or save it as PDF now; later again under Overview → Setup overview or with "godeb summary".

summary.title: Setup of {{host}}
summary.noSecrets: This overview contains no passwords, tokens or private keys. The WireGuard client files are on the server in /etc/wireguard/clients.

tunnel.label: Through the WireGuard tunnel
tunnel.note: Connect the WireGuard tunnel, then open in the browser.

tunnelPeer.label: Through the WireGuard tunnel
tunnelPeer.note: Reachable through the hub's tunnel (phone or laptop connected to the hub).

lan.label: In the home network (HTTPS)
lan.note: Self-signed certificate: compare the fingerprint below.

upload.tooLarge: The file is too large for a WireGuard configuration.
upload.notWireGuard: This is not a WireGuard file ([Interface] and [Peer] are missing).
